name: Andrzej Halicki, Matjaž Nemec - Après le § 72 - Am 103
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 72 a. Is extremely concerned by the lack of investment in the EU’s diplomacy services, calls on the Commission to maintain the funding of those services and, where necessary, to increase it;
